import numpy as np
def equation(eps, T, params):
    a,b,c,d,f,e,g = params[0],params[1],params[2],params[3],params[4],params[5],params[6]
    return a*np.sqrt(T) + b*eps*np.exp(-c*eps)/T + d*np.exp(-f*T)*np.exp(-g*eps) + e
